newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CL's CEPA 1997 warrants open firmer.
newsitem.headline: CL's CEPA 1997 warrants open firmer.

text.p: Call warrants issued by Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia Ltd on Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd began trading at HK$0.540 on Monday, compared with an issue price of HK$0.4635
The warrants were issued on September 24.

In a separate announcement, Credit Lyonnais reminded those holding its 380 million call warrants 1996-1997 on CEPA that the issuer had the option to make a cash payment in lieu of delivery of shares to exercising warrantholders.
The Credit Lyonnais announcement said that each exercising warrantholder would be notified immediately if the issuer elects to make a cash payment in lieu of shares.

CEPA parent Hopewell Holdings Ltd announced last Thursday that the it was selling 80 percent of its holding in CEPA to Southern Co of the U.S. in a move which could lead to the privatisation and delisting of CEPA.
A decision by CEPA shareholders on the Southern takeover plan and delisting of CEPA was likely by the end of the year, the Hopewell announcement said.

If Southern's takeover scheme is accepted by CEPA shareholders and becomes effective, it is expected that the warrants will be withdrawn from listing, the Credit Lyonnais notice said. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6933
